searchText: confirmed a bug in Nimbus that would cause it to send messages with empty seqno/peerid (ie 0 bytes, as opposed to not sending the field at all) - not for messages that originated with nimbus but rather when retransmitting gossip from others whose peerid/seqno was not set we'll be doing a fix shortly
